roots.description: Skill folders to check in addition to .agents/skills, .claude/skills, and .github/skills. Globs allowed, e.g. "src/**/skills".

rules.description: Severity override per diagnostic id, e.g. { "orphan": "off" }.

probe.description: Run `<tool> --help` to check flags of external CLIs.

maxSkillTokens.description: skill-too-large: warn when SKILL.md exceeds this many tokens (default 5000).

allowDiverged.description: skill-diverged: skill names whose copies may differ, e.g. variants.
